title: Fuel independence of circuit unfolding
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs, whose gates have distinct argument vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. For any vertex $v$ and nonnegative fuel bounds $f,f'$ with $v<f$ and $v<f'$, unfolding $v$ with either fuel bound and the same polarity produces the same Boolean circuit tree.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is well formed: each gate has distinct argument vertices and every NOT gate has exactly one argument
